passages.text: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
passages.sermon:
Noah had three sons.
Their names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
This is the account of these sons.
After the flood, Shem, Ham, and Japheth had sons.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת בְּנֵי־ נֹ֔חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֣ם וָיָ֑פֶת וַיִּוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם בָּנִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃

passages.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
passages.sermon: Japheth was one of Noah’s sons.\r\nJapheth had sons.\r\nTheir names were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃

passages.text: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
passages.sermon: Gomer was a son of Japheth.\r\nGomer had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְרִיפַ֖ת וְתֹגַרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
passages.sermon: Javan was a son of Japheth.\r\nJavan had sons.\r\nJavan’s sons were Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּתִּ֖ים וְדֹדָנִֽים׃

passages.text: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Gomer and Javan became many peoples.
These peoples lived near the sea.
They are called the maritime peoples.
They moved into different lands.
Each group had its own language.
Each group belonged to a clan.
Each clan was part of a nation.
passages.original: מֵ֠אֵלֶּה נִפְרְד֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ בְּאַרְצֹתָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לִלְשֹׁנ֑וֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
passages.sermon: Ham was a son of Noah.\r\nHam had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּפ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
passages.sermon:
Cush was a son of Ham.
Cush had five sons.
Their names were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca.
Raamah was one of the sons of Cush.
Raamah had two sons.
Their names were Sheba and Dedan.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥ה וְרַעְמָ֖ה וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖ה שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃

passages.text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
passages.sermon: Cush was the father of Nimrod.\r\nNimrod began to be a mighty one on the earth.
passages.original: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ נִמְרֹ֑ד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִֽהְי֥וֹת גִּבֹּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Nimrod was a mighty hunter.
He lived before the LORD.
People spoke about him.
They said, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD."
passages.original: הֽוּא־ הָיָ֥ה גִבֹּֽר־ צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֙ יֵֽאָמַ֔ר כְּנִמְרֹ֛ד גִּבּ֥וֹר צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
passages.sermon:
Nimrod was a mighty man on the earth.
He began to rule as a king.
His kingdom started in the land of Shinar.
He ruled over Babylon.
He ruled over Erech.
He ruled over Accad.
He ruled over Calneh.
passages.original: וַתְּהִ֨י רֵאשִׁ֤ית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶ֖רֶךְ וְאַכַּ֣ד וְכַלְנֵ֑ה בְּאֶ֖רֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃

passages.text: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah, and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
passages.sermon:
Asshur left that land.
Asshur went into Assyria.
Asshur built Nineveh.
Asshur built Rehoboth-Ir.
Asshur built Calah.
Asshur built Resen.
Resen is between Nineveh and Calah.
Calah is a great city.
passages.original: מִן־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא יָצָ֣א אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ נִ֣ינְוֵ֔ה וְאֶת־ רְחֹבֹ֥ת עִ֖יר וְאֶת־ כָּֽלַח׃ וְֽאֶת־ רֶ֔סֶן בֵּ֥ין נִֽינְוֵ֖ה וּבֵ֣ין כָּ֑לַח הִ֖וא הָעִ֥יר הַגְּדֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites, the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
passages.sermon:
Mizraim was a man.
Mizraim became the father of several peoples.
He was the father of the Ludites.
He was the father of the Anamites.
He was the father of the Lehabites.
He was the father of the Naphtuhites.
He was the father of the Pathrusites.
He was the father of the Casluhites.
The Philistines came from the Casluhites.
He was the father of the Caphtorites.
passages.original: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־ לוּדִ֧ים וְאֶת־ עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־ לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־ נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃ וְֽאֶת־ פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־ כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites, the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites, the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered, and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
passages.sermon:
Canaan was the father of many peoples.
Canaan’s firstborn son was Sidon.
Canaan was also the father of the Hittites.
He was the father of the Jebusites.
He was the father of the Amorites.
He was the father of the Girgashites.
He was the father of the Hivites.
He was the father of the Arkites.
He was the father of the Sinites.
He was the father of the Arvadites.
He was the father of the Zemarites.
He was the father of the Hamathites.
Later, the Canaanite clans were scattered.
The borders of Canaan began at Sidon.
The border went toward Gerar.
It reached as far as Gaza.
The border also went toward Sodom.
It went toward Gomorrah.
It went toward Admah.
It went toward Zeboiim.
The border reached as far as Lasha.
passages.original: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־ צִידֹ֥ן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־ חֵֽת׃ וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃ וְאֶת־ הַֽחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַסִּינִֽי׃ וְאֶת־ הָֽאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־ הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְאַחַ֣ר נָפֹ֔צוּ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃ וַֽיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִצִּידֹ֔ן בֹּאֲכָ֥ה גְרָ֖רָה עַד־ עַזָּ֑ה בֹּאֲכָ֞ה סְדֹ֧מָה וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאַדְמָ֥ה וּצְבֹיִ֖ם עַד־ לָֽשַׁע׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
passages.sermon:
Ham had sons.
Each son belonged to a family group.
Each family group spoke its own language.
Each family group lived in its own land.
Each family group became its own nation.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־ חָ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹֽׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
passages.sermon: Shem was the older brother of Japheth.\r\nShem had sons.\r\nShem became the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
passages.original: וּלְשֵׁ֥ם יֻלַּ֖ד גַּם־ ה֑וּא אֲבִי֙ כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ עֵ֔בֶר אֲחִ֖י יֶ֥פֶת הַגָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
passages.sermon: Shem was a son of Noah.\r\nShem had several sons.\r\nShem’s sons were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י שֵׁ֖ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֑וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֥וּד וַֽאֲרָֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
passages.sermon: Aram was a son of Shem.\r\nAram had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י אֲרָ֑ם ע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמַֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
passages.sermon: Arphaxad was a son of Shem.\r\nArphaxad became the father of Shelah.\r\nShelah became the father of Eber.
passages.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־ עֵֽבֶר׃

passages.text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
passages.sermon:
Eber had two sons.
The first son was named Peleg.
People called him Peleg because the earth was divided during his lifetime.
Eber’s other son was named Joktan.
passages.original: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָֽאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יָקְטָֽן׃

passages.text: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Obal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
passages.sermon:
Joktan was a man from the family of Shem.
Joktan had many sons.
Joktan was the father of Almodad.
Joktan was the father of Sheleph.
Joktan was the father of Hazarmaveth.
Joktan was the father of Jerah.
Joktan was the father of Hadoram.
Joktan was the father of Uzal.
Joktan was the father of Diklah.
Joktan was the father of Obal.
Joktan was the father of Abimael.
Joktan was the father of Sheba.
Joktan was the father of Ophir.
Joktan was the father of Havilah.
Joktan was the father of Jobab.
All these men were sons of Joktan.
passages.original: וְיָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־ שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־ חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ יָֽרַח׃ וְאֶת־ הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־ אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־ דִּקְלָֽה׃ וְאֶת־ עוֹבָ֥ל וְאֶת־ אֲבִֽימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־ שְׁבָֽא׃ וְאֶת־ אוֹפִ֥ר וְאֶת־ חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־ יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן׃

passages.text: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
passages.sermon:
Joktan’s sons lived in a certain land.
Their territory began at Mesha.
Their territory reached to Sephar.
Sephar is in the eastern hill country.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֥י מוֹשָׁבָ֖ם מִמֵּשָׁ֑א בֹּאֲכָ֥ה סְפָ֖רָה הַ֥ר הַקֶּֽדֶם׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
passages.sermon:
Shem was a son of Noah.
Shem had descendants.
These descendants formed different clans.
Each clan had its own language.
Each clan lived in its own land.
Each clan became its own nation.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־ שֵׁ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם לְגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
passages.sermon:
Noah had sons.
Noah’s sons had families.
These families became clans.
Each clan had its own generations.
Each clan became a nation.
All these clans came from Noah’s sons.
After the flood, these clans spread out over the earth.
The nations of the earth came from these clans.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֧ת בְּנֵי־ נֹ֛חַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶ֑ם וּמֵאֵ֜לֶּה נִפְרְד֧וּ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃פ
